coordinate_convention: raw full-resolution pixel coordinates, origin top-left, x right, y down

label_geometry.pixel_xyz_convention: x,y = cam0 raw pixel coordinates; z = cam0.x - cam1.x (horizontal disparity in pixels). z is not metric depth.
label_geometry.three_d_convention: triangulated from raw cam0/cam1 pixels with the saved stereo calibration; Camera-0 and big-ChArUco-board coordinates.
label_geometry.label_z_convention: Displayed Z-up is height_above_board_mm, the signed distance from the saved board surface along up_board. X_board_mm uses pattern axes.
label_geometry.note: Derived geometry is recomputed on every label save and by measure; the raw cam0/cam1 pixels remain authoritative.
